svg.title: Vade: an LLM inference engine and agent harness, written in Rust, built for the DGX Spark
svg.desc: VADE, drawn large in violet and blue monospace characters over a slow, sparse current of dots and dashes, as on vade.lol. A soft light drifts across the letters and the characters under it scramble and settle. An LLM inference engine and agent harness, written in Rust, built for the DGX Spark. Project sites: vade.lol and getvade.com.

g.text: An LLM inference engine and agent harness, written in Rust, built for the DGX Spark.
